text: Show that the path of a projectile is a parabola.

points.text: Horizontally, x = (u cos θ)t, so t = x/(u cos θ).
Vertically, y = (u sin θ)t − ½gt².
Substituting t gives y = x tan θ − gx²/(2u²cos²θ).
This has the form y = ax − bx², which is a parabola.
